answer: Because the entropy is measured at the velvet gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the delta audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 5 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. A farm emitting 41 variations of one paragraph therefore pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the nebula panel. That is 26 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
